reviewed.note: Built from the register maps (translation keys per firmware 2.06 to 7.59), entity_translations.py, value_maps.py and strings.json.

unmapped.buffer_top: The integral units have no buffer temperature in their read map.
unmapped.circulation: The read map has no circulation pump output. dhw_pump is the unit's one pump while the diverter valve sends the flow into the DHW tank (confirmed on a real installation), not a circulation pump.
unmapped.hc_volume: Two sensors share the translation key flow_rate: block pxx0A033B (heat pump flow, used for volume) and block pxxFB offset 55 (heating circuit flow). The display registry carries no unique_id, so they cannot be told apart until the integration gives them separate keys.
unmapped.hours: The integration splits the compressor runtime into heating, hot water and cooling; no total exists. The parts are in the details.
unmapped.energy_total: Electricity is counted per use only (electr_hc_*, electr_dhw_*); no total over all uses exists. The parts are in the tiles.
